ResetCommands.Comment: * Snotling Trolls playing in the maze
* Guards in front of the treasure room
* Male trolls in SW Cut Corridor
* Kings room to maze (closed and locked)
* Kings room to court (closed and locked)

Rooms.Name: Cave Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are before an entrance to a cave which reaches back into the hills. 
As you look inside, you see nothing but shadows and darkness.  You think 
to yourself, "Self, what a wonderful place to find vile, evil creatures 
worth slaying."  Then you think to yourself, "If they don't get me 
first."

Rooms.Name: Inside the Dark Cave Entrance
Rooms.Description:
Just inside the cave, you see darkness quite clearly.  The darkness 
turns quickly to absolute blackness.  You wonder how anyone with 
infravision could even see in that.  You see scratchings on the cave 
walls which make you think this might not be a completely natural cave.

Rooms.Name: Deeper Inside the Cave
Rooms.Description:
As you wait here, your eyesight starts to become more accustomed to the 
dark.  You see the cave entrance vaguely starting to widen out to the 
east.  The natural cuts in the grey rock wall seems to absorb your light
as you walk through here.

Rooms.Name: Cave Junction
Rooms.Description:
You see what looks like an obvious guard post here.  It is perfect for 
watching all three paths, especially those coming into the cave.  The
natural grey walls to the north and south almost seem to be cut.

Rooms.Name: E/S Turn
Rooms.Description:
The corridor turns south to east.  The hard grey stone wall is covered
with a green moss that is slick to the touch.  The tunnel south is 
obviously been cut from the stone as is the tunnel to the east.

Rooms.Name: Four Way Corridor Junction
Rooms.Description:
The corridor branches in all four cardinal directions.  You can see 
the corridors continuing.  Leaning against the edge between two openings,
you balance some and notice the stone seems to be very hard and holds an
edge quite well.  The path east looks well worn from use.

Rooms.Name: Corridor Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The corridor runs north - south having been enlarged from a natural 
tunnel.  The stone here almost sparkles when light reflects off the 
walls.  It is like little rainbows of light.

Rooms.Name: East/South Turn
Rooms.Description:
The corridor turns east from the south.  It seems to travel a ways
ahead in both directions, but then again, appearances could be 
deceiving.  The stone here is the same basic grey stone.

Rooms.Name: East/West Corridor
Rooms.Description:
You stand in an East/West corridor with a passage to the north.  
Looking north, you see what might be the start of a cavern.  To the 
east, the passage appears to end.

Rooms.Name: A Large Empty Cavern
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the south part of a large, empty, cavern.  The cavern 
extends to the north and returns to a corridor to the south.  A trickle
of water runs down the west wall and seeps down a small hole in the 
floor.

Rooms.Name: A Large Empty Cavern
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the north end of a large, empty, cavern.  As you prepare 
to leave, you see a faint brown stain on the floor that is crusty and
easily brushed off with your foot.

Rooms.Name: End of the Corridor
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the east end of a corridor.  You can go back west or try 
to sneak around a rock to the north, which you can see leads into a 
room.

Rooms.Name: Troll Wardroom
Rooms.Description:
In here, you see some furniture with some battered and oversized piece 
of worthless armor casually tossed over it.  You wonder that the armor
can even protect anything as it's so full of holes.  You realize that 
most of this stuff, if you could haul it out, might fetch a copper bit, 
if you were that lucky. This is obviously a place where troll guards dump 
their stuff before going to sleep.

Rooms.Name: SW Quadrant of a Guard Barracks
Rooms.Description:
You either stepped inside of a pig pen or else inside of a troll guard 
barracks.  Raising your nose and taking a deep sniff, you realize it must
be trolls, because pigs smell better.  The room continues east and north
with a passage back to the west.

Rooms.Name: SE Quadrant of a Troll Barracks
Rooms.Description:
Pig pen is a more common response by now.  There seems to be straw, or 
something else that is stringy like it, matted together with filth and
sweat.  You think if it wasn't for the sweat and filth, it might be a 
place to sleep.  You see the room continue north and west.

Rooms.Name: NW Quadrant of a Guard Barracks
Rooms.Description:
More of the same garden variety stinky, smelly, troll beds are here. 
The only seeming thing of worth here is what is with you right now.  
You start to wonder what a troll might consider a valuable treasure.

Rooms.Name: NE Quadrant of a Guard Barracks
Rooms.Description:
You see more of the same, a pile of sleeping pallets with openings to the 
west and south. A door, or a peace of wood slammed so hard it hasn't fallen
yet is on the north wall.  One of the pallets here seems to be more special
then the rest in that it has some hides crumpled across it.

Rooms.Name: A Lesser Used Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This tunnel is smaller then the other one.  It also seems artificially 
widened as the grey rock looks smoother then what you have seen in these 
tunnels.  This path seems not well used as it turns east and north.

Rooms.Name: A Lesser Used Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This dusty tunnel widened through the grey rock makes a turn south 
from the west.  There is still dust on the floor, though it looks a
little stirred.  That probably was from a breeze at some time.

Rooms.Name: A Widening of the Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel becomes wider to the east and narrower to the north.  
Peering to the east you see it starting to open up to a room.  Looking
north you see it turn left up a ways.

Rooms.Name: SW Corner of the Ogre Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room has a disgusting aroma.  Smells like someone or something is 
living here and is not to particular about cleanliness.  The floor seems
splotched with something dark brown, which covers some of the natural 
grey stone.  Bits and pieces of bones and hides are also scattered 
across the floor.  This room is large and extends north and west.  A 
cave tunnel runs west of here.

Rooms.Name: SE Corner of the Ogre Chamber
Rooms.Description:
The room still smells, but now worse then before.  The carpet of dark 
brown still stains the floor, though some reddish brown seems to have 
muddied into the mixture.  To the north, you see a pile of stuff all 
over the floor.

Rooms.Name: NE Corner of the Ogre Chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the biggest pile of trash and refuse you have seen 
in ages.  You wonder how anything can live here.  You also wonder how 
you haven't slipped and fallen down yet when you step around the stuff.
The room opens west and south.

Rooms.Name: NW Corner of the Ogre Chamber
Rooms.Description:
To the east comes a vulgar smell to match the garbage strewn all over 
the place.  Most of the stink seems to be coming from the east.  The 
large room extends south and east.

Rooms.Name: Southern corridor
Rooms.Description:
This cut grey stone corridor ends with an entrance to the east. Peering
some into the room to the east, it looks more like a large chamber.  A
fourway junction is to the north of here.

Rooms.Name: Large Empty Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room is a large,natural chamber that wasn't cut by any creatures
hand.  As you gaze to the east, you see the chamber continue.  You see
stalactites above you with some sort of clear water dripping down.  A 
less then natural exit was cut to the west, leading into a corridor.

Rooms.Name: Large Empty Chamber
Rooms.Description:
The beauty of this room, you think, is lost on the those living here,
but you think you do see the source of some of their stone clubs.  Some 
of the stalactites seem to have broken off the ceiling and fallen to the 
floor as several lay scattered here.  The room extends west of here.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The grey stone corridor is cut deep into the rock, with the walls 
slightly smooth.  The corridor winds north and snakes west.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
Looking at the walls, you can tell this must not have been a natural
cave or tunnel, but something that bored through the rock.  Whatever it
was, it's something you probably wouldn't like to meet here.  The grey
stone corridor turns south and east.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The grey stone corridor's north wall is slightly stratified with some 
other type of rock as it layers with a grayish green stone.  The stone 
seems to crumble easier then the grey rock does.  The corridor goes 
east to a southern turn and west quite a ways.

Rooms.Name: Junction in a Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
You are in a T-intersection which runs east and west, but also has a 
path to the south.  Looking east, the corridor retreats into darkness,
while looking south, it seems to enter into a larger room of some sort.

Rooms.Name: NW Corner of a Large Trollop Room
Rooms.Description:
This room is large and full of furs strewn across the room.  This 
looks cozy and comfortable in a strange sort of way, like a room where 
some young are suckled by their mothers.  The room is large and extends
east and south, while an opening to the north leads to a corridor.

Rooms.Name: SW Corner of a Large Trollop Room
Rooms.Description:
This large room extends north and east, and as you walk around here,
you start to wonder what a female troll might be called.  As you look
at the furs, you notice that they almost seem to be more carefully 
laid out then just scattered about.

Rooms.Name: SE Corner of a Large Trollop Room
Rooms.Description:
This large room continues north and west of here.  The floor almost 
seems clean.  At least, less dirty then the rest of the cave.

Rooms.Name: NE Corner of a Large Trollop Room
Rooms.Description:
More of the large room still lays further to the south and west of 
here.  Furs are scattered all around this room, but a couple seem to 
catch your eye.  One in particular which looks well worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you move the worn fur when examining it, you notice that its old
and worn, but more importantly, you notice a trapdoor hidden under it.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut deep into the same grey boring rock, with the 
walls slightly smooth.  The corridor continues east and west of here.

Rooms.Name: End of the Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The bored (or boring) corridor finally ends.  To the east you see a 
what looks like a guard station in front of a heavy door.  To the north 
and south, you see what looks like a some sort of small niche of a 
room. The corridor continues west.

Rooms.Name: Guard Room
Rooms.Description:
This small room has been cut from the same rock that is commonly 
found all over the place.  Its not only small, but is mostly occupied
by a table and two chairs.  This must be a place to sleep when no one 
is looking as the table doesn't look good for much else.  An opening 
is in the south wall, leading to a corridor cut from the same grey 
stone.

Rooms.Name: Guard Room
Rooms.Description:
This small room has more space then the one to the north as it has one
less chair here then the other does.  Other then that, it's identical, 
except the opening is to the north and not the south.

Rooms.Name: Outside Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
This seems to be a good spot to guard a throne room, providing you
had a throne room to guard here.  It is obvious from the worn floor and 
scuffed wall that this is well used area.  There are doors to the east 
and the corridor continues west of here.

Rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a large room with a Throne on the east side of the room, many 
steps a way.  The room is also cut from the native grey rock.  The room 
continues to the north, south, and east, while the doors are behind you 
to the west.

Rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a large room with a Throne to the south and east of here. The
hard grey stone seems worn smooth on the walls.  The room continues to 
the south, and east.

Rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a large room with a Throne to the south and east.  If you go 
east some, you think you might be able to stand in front of the throne.
Feeling the north wall, it feels cold to the touch.  The large room 
continues to the south, west, and east.

Rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a large throne room with the customary throne a few steps
east of here.  A door leading to a corridor lies west of here.  The 
room continues in all directions from here.

Rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the southwest corner of a large throne room.  The room
opens to the north and east from here.  A large dark brown stain 
decorates the wall at about, um, (measuring it with your eye), human
head height.  Obviously someone (or thing) had a mild disagreement here.

Rooms.Name: Troll Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
The large room throne room extends to the north, west and east from 
here.  The throne itself lies some to the west and north from here. You
figure you might sneak to in front of the throne by inching west then
north from here.

Rooms.Name: In Front of the Troll Throne
Rooms.Description:
You stand before the awesome throne of the Troll King.  The throne is
large and cut from a single piece of (what else) grey stone.  The throne
isn't very ornate, but it can fit the rather large bulk of the troll king
in it.  Peering at the side of the throne, you notice a small pathway 
moving around throne to the east.  The rest of the room continues north, 
south, and west of here.

Rooms.Name: Behind the Troll Throne
Rooms.Description:
You stand behind the throne in a slightly cramped area.  After looking 
around, you see a trapdoor.  Examining the trapdoor, you see a small 
keyhole.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from a hard rock that is not grey (more a black 
stone) and appears slightly narrower then the enlarged corridors upstairs.  
You are at the bottom of some stairs cut into the stone.  The corridor 
goes west a short ways and south from here.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor cut from a black rock ends in a door to the west.  The 
tunnel continues to the east from here.  The Door looks solid and capable
of resting many futile attempts at smashing it open.

Rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
Rooms.Description:
This large room holds many chests, most of which seem empty.  Others 
seem filled with rotted trash.  You start to wonder what the trolls 
thought was so valuable here.  The room extends north and west, while a
heavy door to the east leads out of this room.

Rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
Rooms.Description:
This large room HAS to have SOMETHING of value, in here you think, 
but who knows what they consider valuable?  The rock wall here seems 
slightly chipped like someone tried taking an axe to it, with the wall
wining the fight.  The room opens to the west and south from here.

Rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
Rooms.Description:
This large room holds many chests, containing trash.  Some of it looks
like it might have held something of worth a long time back.  the room 
opens to the east and south.

Rooms.Name: Large Treasure Room
Rooms.Description:
A Strong barred door lies to the south in this rather large but 
worthless room.  The room that was cut from black stone opens to the 
north and east of here.

Rooms.Name: Secret Treasure Room
Rooms.Description:
This room holds many chests, most of which seem empty.  Others seem 
filled with rotted trash, but there are a few things tucked around here
-- or at least there should be.  A door lies to the north of here leading
out of this room.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
This corridor is cut from a strange black rock, but is narrower then the
corridors above.  To the north, the hall extends and turns left.  To the 
south stands a room.

Rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, extending west and south from here and
containing many creates and barrels.  The barrels contain a foul smelling
brew of some sort.  Drawing some out in a cup, you see it slightly colored 
yellow, like a very weak beer.  You hesitate at sampling the stuff.

Rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, containing many creates and barrels.  You 
are in the northwest corner with the rest of the room opening to the south
and east of here.  Looking in a crate are the remains of something that 
had to be living at one time.  Little bugs seem to be crawling around in 
it.  About this time, you are positive you don't want to be a dinner
guest here (especially if you ARE the dinner).

Rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, containing many creates and barrels.  You 
are in the southwest corner with the rest of the room laying to the north 
and east of here.  A passage stretches to the south, which leads to a 
corridor cut from black rock.

Rooms.Name: Large Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This room seems to be large, containing many creates and barrels.  
Inside one of the crates are some bag of dust. Sampling some, you are
sure it's grain that is about as old as IO. You are in the southeast 
corner with the room stretching north and west of here.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from a hard black rock, slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs.  The corridor continues west while to the
north is a passage leading into a large room.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
A black rock makes up the walls here.  It crumbles some to a good
sharp blow, but not by much.  The corridor is slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs. The corridor turns both to the west and south.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The cut black rock corridor is still slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs, but seems better used.  the stone seems to
eat any light that radiates from sources, making infravision real tough
down here. The corridor seems to go north and east from here.

Rooms.Name: End of an Unused Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This is a little used tunnel which has collected much dust on the 
floor.  It seems like it was hastily made at one time to allow smaller
creatures than trolls a means of sneaking in and out of here.  It runs
south from here.

Rooms.Name: Unused Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This north/south tunnel is obviously not made for trolls, which has
you wondering who might have made it.  It is to large for dwarves, but
too small for trolls.  Humans wouldn't have a need to live here, so who
made this tunnel?

Rooms.Name: Unused Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A stair case cut from the stone leads up from here to parts unknown,
since a trapdoor seems to block the path.  You stand at the south end 
of a small, narrow tunnel that seems little used from all the dust 
scattered on the floor.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from the same hard black rock seen all over
down here and is slightly narrower then the enlarged corridors found
upstairs. The corridor winds west and south.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
Looking east, you see a dark path continuing on.  Looking north, you
see some more dark path continuing on.  You start wondering why trolls 
like living in places like this that have a lot of walking just to go 
nowhere.

Rooms.Name: Cut Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor is cut from a hard rock, slightly narrower then the 
enlarged corridors upstairs. The corridor goes west and north.  The 
north passage leads to an apparent room.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a maze of rooms.  There seems to be a passage in 
all four directions. All the paths look identical and you are confused 
as to where you might be down here.

Rooms.Name: Maze Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the entrance to a maze of rooms.  The room opens 
to the south and goes east to a hallway guarded by a door. Looking south, 
you see the path open up to a fourway intersection.

Rooms.Name: Private Corridor
Rooms.Description:
This lonely corridor runs between the two rooms and you think its a sort
of quick path somewhere as short as the path seems to be.  To the east is 
a small room and to the west is a large room.

Rooms.Name: Troll King's Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a nice room, for a troll.  You feel like you have shrunk 
because of the proportions of the furniture.  The room, though large, 
looks normal for the size of the bed, dresser, table and chairs 
scattered about the room.  A passage runs west down a small hallway.  
You can wander around the bed to the south or a dresser to the east.

Rooms.Name: Troll King's Room
Rooms.Description:
You stand by the bed here.  Examining the bed, you are glad you aren't 
the one living here as you jump back before being attacked by some rather
large lice.  You can walk beside the bed to the north or the table 
to the east.

Rooms.Name: Troll King's Room
Rooms.Description:
Having walked in this room, you now know how a dwarf must feel.  The 
size of the bed, dresser, table and chairs remind you how big trolls 
really are.  This portion has the dresser, but you can walk around it to 
the west or towards the table to the south.  The dresser looks more like
topless crates that move in and out of a frame.  Jerking hard, you barely
slide one of the "drawers" out a bit enough to see something that passes
for troll clothes.

Rooms.Name: Troll King's Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a nice room, for a troll.  You feel like you have shrunk 
because of the proportions of the furniture.  The room, though large, 
looks normal for the size of the bed, dresser, table and chairs.  There 
is an enormous table here, which you can walk around.  To the north is a 
dresser and the west is the bed.  To the south is a passageway cut from a
dark grey stone.

Rooms.Name: Corridor
Rooms.Description:
This corridor is cut from a dark grey stone and runs South from here.
To the north is a large, regal room.  To the east is a smaller, cozier 
room (in comparison).

Rooms.Name: King's Study
Rooms.Description:
This room holds a clean desk.  (What did you expect, that trolls could 
read?)  There is a hallway to the west.  This seems to be a place where 
someone large, say a troll king, could hide from his troubles of ruling 
his hoard.

Rooms.Name: Corridor
Rooms.Description:
The hallway continues south and north and appears to be well used 
judging by the ruts left in the stone floor.  Looking at the ruts, you 
now start to wonder just how heavy trolls really are and make a mental
note not to find out by letting one fall on you.

Rooms.Name: Bottom of Stairs
Rooms.Description:
The hallway ends here in a set of stairs leading up.  To the north, 
the cut dark grey stone hallway continues.  This seems to be a reasonably
well used walkway judging by the ruts in the floor.  Looking up the stairs,
you see them wind up to a trapdoor.

Mobs.Name: Troll King
Mobs.LongDescription: A large imposing troll stands before you.
Mobs.Description:
Before you stands a very large; a very ugly; troll.  He gives off an 
odor that is typical of these ugly brutes.

Mobs.Name: Troll Captain
Mobs.LongDescription: The Captain of the Troll Guard looks menacingly about him.
Mobs.Description:
A competant, but ugly, troll stands before you decked out in 
an odd assortment of armor pillaged from his different victims.

Mobs.Name: Troll Queen
Mobs.LongDescription: A regal looking female troll stands before you.
Mobs.Description:
A regal looking female troll stands here looking regal in her "beauty".
It takes a  troll to understand it.

Mobs.Name: Troll Guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A troll stands here guarding something.
Mobs.Description:
You see an average everyday troll guard standing here ready to pound
you into the ground with his sledgehammer fists.

Mobs.Name: Male Troll
Mobs.LongDescription: An ordinary, under-the-bridge type troll looks suspiciously at you.
Mobs.Description:
This looks like a common, average, everday, find under the bridge, troll
you see almost under every bridge being crossed by billy goats.

Mobs.Name: Female Troll
Mobs.LongDescription: A female troll overwhelms you with her bad breath.
Mobs.Description:
This is a comon troll that you see almost any where.  She looks like
she can be a tad dangerous.

Mobs.Name: Ogre Chief
Mobs.LongDescription: A large ogre stands before you cracking his knuckles.
Mobs.Description:
A rather large (and rather dumb) ogre stands before you.  The way he
besides nuts, in those rather large hands of his.

Mobs.Name: Male Ogre
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge ogre stands before you.

Mobs.Name: Snotling Child Ogre
Mobs.LongDescription: A snotling childish ogre wipes his nose on you.  Ewww!
Mobs.Description:
The little snotling is remarkably dirty, even for an ogre!  He
seems to be playing some childish game using bones.

Mobs.Name: Snotling Child Troll
Mobs.LongDescription: A snotling childish troll plays here.
Mobs.Description:
Snotling trolls look a lot like adult trolls ... big, meaty, mean,
with low foreheads and a "Make my day" kind of aggressive stance.

Objects.Name: Troll king key
Objects.Description: A plain and rusty key found on the king lies here.

Objects.Name: troll captain key
Objects.Description: A plain, but rusty key found on the troll captain lies here.

Objects.Name: troll belt
Objects.Description: An ugly leather belt of some proportions lies here.

Objects.Name: troll club
Objects.Description: A small uprooted tree lays here.

Objects.Name: troll armour suit shield
Objects.Description: A crumpled suit of armour with a handle lays here.

Objects.Name: troll loincloth trollish leathery
Objects.Description: A pile of smelly, leathery material lays here.
